subject: MAP: Brightline Health - map draft + blockers / proposed next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@brightlinehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (Brightline)

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (Brightline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx). Please skim and flag anything missing. Key points: 

- Objective: Reduce inference latency for our clinical assistant by 60% while staying within your monthly cost target.
- Proposed target close date: 2026-08-31 (TBD based on procurement).
- High-level milestones (from call):
  1) Scoping + success criteria sign-off — Alice / Clinical Leads — target 8/11
  2) Security & procurement checklist — Procurement (Brightline) + Redwood Security — target 8/18
  3) Technical POC (2-week) — Engineering owners: Ben (Redwood) + Brightline Eng — 8/19–9/2
  4) Contract + SOW finalization — Legal/Procurement — 8/25–8/31

Owners and dependencies are in the attached MAP. Immediate asks: 
- Alice: can you confirm the internal stakeholders for "scoping + sign-off" and whether the 8/11 milestone is realistic?
- Procurement: please share your SOC 2 self-attestation or checklist items we should surface to Redwood (I can spin up a shared folder).
- Ben: will take the technical POC ownership if Brightline is okay with the proposed 2-week window.

I’ll follow up with an updated MAP based on any notes. If useful, we can book a short alignment call next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Brightline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (xlsx, 26 KB)

From: Alice Monroe <alice@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Brightline Health Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (Brightline)

Thanks Karthik — that matches my notes. Two quick items from procurement and our legal partner: 

- Target close date: procurement would prefer end of August but needs a 2–3 week review window for contract redlines. Realistically we can aim for 2026-08-31 but may need to push by a week if SOC2 evidence or custom terms appear.
- Procurement asked for a one-page summary of data residency, retention, and audit log capabilities (they attached our own checklist for reference).

I’m looping procurement on this thread. Procurement note attached (Procurement_requirements_0805.pdf).

Also: my internal stakeholder list for scoping/sign-off will include Dr. Miguel Santos (Clinical Lead), Priya Rao (Head of Product), and Jae Kim (Engineering manager). I’ll confirm who will attend the scoping call by Friday 8/7.

Appreciate the MAP — I’ll review and give feedback on owners by EOD Friday.

Best,
Alice
Director of Product, Brightline Health
alice@brightlinehealth.com

Attachment: Procurement_requirements_0805.pdf (pdf, 43 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@brightlinehealth.com>, Brightline Health Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v1.2 attached — adjusted owners and proposed dates

Hi Alice / Procurement — thanks for the quick reply and the procurement checklist. I’ve updated the MAP to capture the stakeholders you named and to call out the procurement dependencies explicitly (attached Brightline_MAP_v1.2.xlsx). Summary of changes: 

- Milestone adjustments: moved "scoping sign-off" to 8/11 (pending attendee confirmations).
- Security milestone: added a subtask for "SOC 2 evidence drop" (owner: Redwood Security; dependency: procurement checklist items).
- Technical POC: Ben will lead Redwood's side; proposed start date 8/19 assuming scoping finishes 8/11 and procurement sign-off by 8/18.
- Contract timeline: moved earlier to begin redline conversations 8/20 to allow time for a one-week legal review before 8/31 close.

Immediate asks / next steps: 
- Alice: confirm scoping attendees by EOD Friday 8/7 (I’ll send a calendar invite once confirmed).
- Procurement: please flag any items in your checklist that would block an 8/18 procurement sign-off — we can capture those as MAP dependencies.
- Ben: if the POC needs any particular infra or sample data we should prepare, flag now so we can include it in the POC prep milestone.

I’ve also added a HubSpot link to the deal notes: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2345678 — feel free to add any procurement artifacts there.

Thanks — updated MAP attached.

—
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Brightline_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (xlsx, 34 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP v1.2 attached — adjusted owners and proposed dates

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note before we push v1.2 externally: 

- Recommend moving "Security attestation" earlier (right after scoping) so procurement has time to review evidence before the POC. If procurement needs a full package we should schedule a 1-hour evidence handoff the week of 8/10.
- Ben: please prepare a short POC runbook (1–2 pages) listing infra requirements, sample payloads, and expected test cases — I'll attach that to the MAP before we send v1.3.
- Also let's add a risk row for "data de-identification" and note whether Brightline will provide de-identified samples or whether Redwood should provide a sanitized dataset.

I'll consolidate these changes and send an internal draft of v1.3 for your review before we re-send to Brightline.

Laura
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Monroe <alice@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Brightline Health Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP v1.2 attached — adjusted owners and proposed dates

Thanks Karthik and team — this is helpful. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- Procurement will review the checklist and aim to surface any blocking items by EOD 8/13. They asked us to schedule legal review the week of 8/17 (that should be fine).
- We can commit to a scoping call on 8/11 — I’ll send the invite with Dr. Santos and Priya.
- On the POC: Brightline will provide de-identified sample payloads. We’ll share the sample spec with Ben on the scoping call.

Next asks: 
- Karthik / Laura: please send MAP v1.3 with the earlier "security attestation" milestone and attach Ben’s POC runbook after you have it.
- Procurement: I’ll follow up internally and drop any blocking items on this thread.

If we can get v1.3 by 8/12, procurement will have time to start their review ahead of the 8/18 target.

Best,
Alice
Director of Product, Brightline Health
